The coordinated activity across multiple accounts suggests a card-not-present fraud pattern.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-22 and 2016-12-29, a single device profile (FRD-L09 Build/HUAWEIFRD-L09) was used to conduct transactions across 8 different card accounts. On 2016-12-26, transaction 3576545 for $74.93 was processed online for cardholder C06343. This cardholder also had a $149.93 transaction (3573558) on 2016-12-25 using the same device. The device profile is unusual, appearing on only 8 cards in a six-month period, all within this specific timeframe. Other connected cards include C02515-K2, C02575-K2, and C13284-K1. The aggregate activity across the 9 cardholders involved 9 transactions totaling $974.91. This pattern of a shared device profile across multiple unrelated accounts is indicative of coordinated card-not-present fraud. The bank has blocked card C06343-K1 and placed connected cards under monitoring. This report is filed due to the connection to a shared device profile and suspected coordinated abuse.
